data.why: The repo ships no example spectra, so a synthetic multi-block JCAMP-DX file was written matching the ##TITLE=/##XYPOINTS=(XY..XY)/##CONCENTRATIONS= format the parser expects, with a 'sal' sample group (Sal1-Sal9), a Sal7/Sal7bis duplicate pair, a Sal5 spectral outlier (spike at 1300 nm despite normal L,a,b), and Sal9 missing L,a,b to exercise outlier detection, duplicate averaging, and PLS target-missing handling.

goals: Load multi-block JDX NIR spectra and inspect the raw wavelength x sample matrix
Screen samples for spectral outliers using distance-from-mean SNV diagnostics and exclude one with a documented reason
Check reproducibility of an original/bis duplicate pair and average them into the working dataset
Explore sample structure with PCA scores/loadings colored by L, a, b colorimetric values
Run Ward hierarchical clustering and pick the number of clusters via silhouette score
Fit a PLS regression of SNV spectra on a colorimetric target (L, a, or b) with leave-one-out cross-validation and compare calibration vs. CV performance

review.summary: The tree follows the workflow the README describes, from raw JDX spectra through outlier and duplicate checks, SNV, PCA and Ward clustering to PLS with leave-one-out cross-validation, with accurate Italian specifics and screens that match. The second agent replayed every task and feature, and the fixes listed are optional (step order, one sample count, a few more features), so it can be filed as is.
